:::{#def-irreducible-risk}
#### Residual risk (irreducible risk)

The **residual risk** (also called the **irreducible risk**)
is the [squared-error risk](#def-squared-error-risk) of the [conditional expectation function](#def-cond-expectation-function) $\truemean$ of @thm-risk-decomposition:

$$\popriskf{\truemean} = \E{\sqf{\prederrf{\truemean}}}$$

:::
